summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a multi-tranche offering of senior callable fixed-to-fixed reset rate notes and floating rate notes due 2030-2047. The filing is a routine debt issuance with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. Terms are preliminary and subject to completion. The filing does not involve a change of control, strategic review, or activist campaign. It is a standard capital markets transaction for a financial institution, not reportable as a special situation.
